tei:div.tei:p: (181)rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ bla ma bde chen 'dug rgyu rtswa rtse tsam med pa 'di sdod tshugs te sgrub pa'i sa sde tshugs par byin gyis rlobs/ bskyed rdzogs gong ma'i kha skad bzang kyang*/ dang po chos kyi rkang ma tshug na mi phan pas/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal tu shes nas gang byas sdug bsngal gyi snon mar go zhing sha ba btson dong nas bros 'dod lta bu'i blo sna thung sbud de med par dal kham re 'ga' ni chos/ dal na sgrub/ brel na bzhag rkyen ngan re byung dus rgyang gyis bskur rgyu'i chos des sems 'di thar lam skogs gi mi 'dug thar pa'i 'bras bu gang yang rung ba re la thob 'dod skom pa chu gdung lta bu'i bsam pa med na/ 'bras bu phan yon ma shes pas/ lam la bslob 'dod pa de rgyal po'i ngan khral bzhin bla (182)ma'i ngo mtshar chog pa tsam las rnam dag lam gyi dmigs par mi 'gyur/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal du shes nas de las bros te thar pa gang rung thod 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi bsam pa mtshan nyid pa re rgyud la ma skyes par theg dman gyi 'bras bu la rtsogs pa bltas nas/ rjogs chen zer ba'i mtho skad la re nas mig de gzengs lta stangs gcer/ sems gsal rig gi 'jin pa gcig ma gsar mas bu 'jin pa bzhin/ sems bsgom gzungs 'jin re dogs kyis bcing*/ stong nyid kyis lta bas rtsis ma zin pa'i byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra ba'i lta sgom des sa gang yang mi chod par ma zad sems 'jin gtad so can des slad ma'i 'khor ba rgyu 'bras rgyud la 'dren pas sgom dga' che na khams gong ma'i las mi 'phags pas mgo med 'jug med kyi sgom chen la bzang rgyu med/ yang 'chi ba (183)mi rtag pa 'di rgyun chags su dran zhing rgyud la ma sbyar na/ thun re re gnyis gnyis la bsam pas gang yang mi phan/ mje po rkang chad lag sdum la sman thun re re gnyis gnyis mi phan pa bzhin yin/

'chidus dam pa'i chos dam gtogs pa skyabs dang gling dang mgon dang dpung gnyen sogs med pa'i zhib tu bsam na chos la gal chung du song*/ tshe 'di'i zas gos sogs 'di snang la rts-is po cher song*/ tshul 'chos gyi mi sngon jo mo btsun tshugs dang bzang mdog gis rang gis rang bslus pas 'chi khar 'gyod pa chen po skye bar 'gyur ta re/ chos byas pa mis ma rig na mi mgu'i dgos pas chos la pho byas byas mo'i dpa' skad sgrogs zhing bla ma la sgrub pa'i dam bca' ri rab tsam re byas/ nyams len til 'bru tsam yang mi byed pa'i nag po'i chos 'dis rang nyid ngan 'gror (184)bskyur ba gdon mi za/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa 'chi dus chos ma gtogs gang gis mi phan par shes blo sna thung sbud re ba'i steng nas/ gzhan don du rang nyid sangs rgyas thob 'dod bsam pa bcos ma ma yin pa zhig rgyud la skyes kyis bar khrid rim la yar skyed bton na rang rgyud la yar skyed med par ma zad/ rang 'dod kyi blo rtse grwa zeng nge ba byas nas bdag byang chub sems dpa' 'o skams pa nga rgyal gyi go ba skam pos mi 'ong bas byang chub kyi sems 'di rgyud la skyes pa'i thabs tshad med bzhi dang byams snying gnyis blo yang yang skyang*/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba gdabs/ bsam pa bzang po skye ba'i phyir tshogs bsag rgya gang che nas dgos/ tshogs ril mjub mo tsam ser sna zin bzhin du mchod/ de la dngos grub g.yag ro tsam re 'ong re ba zhe 'dod dang lag len 'jol/ bsam ngan rang 'dod 'di sdig sgrib las byung bas (185)bshags sbyong gnad gang zab nas byed dgos/ sems 'gyod sdom gang yang med pa'i kha stong nang nas mthol mthol bshags bshags kyis tho med kyi sdig pa gtan mi 'dags/ byang chub kyi sems 'di skye ba'i sgo du ma nas 'bad dgos/ 'di nam rgyud la skyes na stong nyid rtogs zer ba dang mi 'dra/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ma nor ba yin pas 'di phyi gnyis dkar 'tshengs tshar ba yin pas spyod lam thams cad du ma brjod par blo sbyong*/

'di 'dra'i blo sbyong sems kyi bsam 'dug legs nyes tsam la blo sna mi khug par dka' snang dang 'tsher snang chen po byas/ rdzogs pa chen po sogs bskyed rdzogs bsgom sla sla mor bsam pa ni yid rnal mar mi gnas pa yin pas/ des na sangs rgyas go 'phang gi yon tan de rgyu gang gis thob na dam pa'i chos kyis thob/ chos rgyud ldan gyi gang zag nyes zad phyag 'os (186)yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po shes nas dkon mchog la dad pa mi 'phrog pa zhig med na/ chos pa bzang po yin zer ba rnams chos gzhugs mi 'khyong bar tshe 'di'i gnyer kha je cher song nas mi byed dgu byed gcig red gi 'dug pa rang gzhan la mthong thos mang bas des na/ bla ma la 'jal dka' ba'i 'du shes/ chos dang 'phrad dka' ba'i 'du shes kyis/ dang po sgo kun nas thos pa rgya ci che zhig byas/ rang gzhan gyi phyogs zhen spong*/ nyams len la sgro 'dog chod pa zhig bya/ sa gcig tu sdod nas sgrub pa'i sa sde tshugs pa zhig byas na dngos grub dang yon tan sna re skye/ de tsam ma byung na thar pa'i sa bon yang dag pa re thebs/ de ma yin par bla ma mjal mjal dang gdams ngag thob thob gyis blo sna tshim/ dpe rul yig rul byi ba'i tshang rtsa tsam gyis blo bde'i don med pas (187)bsam blo legs par thongs/ blalo chos la 'gro dus na yar skyed bton nas/ snga ma de'i steng bskyed rim rnam pa gsal zhing rnam dag dran pa nga rgyal brtan pa gzung rnam lhar shar zhing*/ 'jin rnam stong nyid du dag pa'i rig stong ljen seng nge ba byung dus snga 'gyur ba'i bskyed rjogs zung 'jug gam/ bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyis rgyas btab pa zer ba de yin pas gal po che red kyang*/ dang po chos kyi rkang legs so zhig ma sgom nyams len gyi byas mdog rang rgyud chud za ba la sa med pa yin pas rgyu mtshan shes pas bskyed rdzogs kyi don dga' na kha rje che/

de min par mtho stabs byed na rgyud je gyong je gyong ko gyong 'dra bar song ba deng song gi sgom chen 'di tsho la ltos/ go rgan bad chen 'di gdams ngag zhu bar rem/ nyams su ni mi len/ blo sna (188)mang*/ sdod mi tshugs/ 'gro ba dga'/ mched gros la 'thab 'dod/ sbyin bdag la mkhong rkyen pa 'di tsho mkha' 'gro snying thig gi chos bdag skyes bu'i lung bstan las karma dpa' bo'i rigs kyi rtags bshad pa dang mtshungs so/ chos smra ba tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa dge bar gyur cig /
